The exact owner-local inventories show matching initial edges in both composites are conditional=True. A guarded edge in one sibling does not establish an unconditional default entry in either sibling, so the violation reading remains established.
decisions.violated_obligation: HighwayMode and UrbanMode must each provide their required owner-local unconditional default entry.

decisions.basis: Pair-0029 dossier for NL1 AutonomousMode initial entry, exact owner-local inventory, S2 plan, and completed receipt.
decisions.reason: NL1 requires AutonomousMode to initially enter InitialState. The exact owner-local initial inventory has no target edge to InitialState, and the completed native check records the exact source-to-target transition as absent. A child-region edge or guarded routing edge would not satisfy this owner-local default-entry contract.
decisions.violated_obligation: AutonomousMode must initially enter InitialState through an owner-local default entry.

decisions.basis: Pair-0029 dossier for CollisionAvoidance reachability, exact scope and bound behavior, G1 plan, and completed receipt.
decisions.reason: NL12 and NL13 impose required behavior within CollisionAvoidance. The exact finite reachability facts mark state:CollisionAvoidance:line:89 and its bound behavior unreachable from the top-level initial entry. Owner-local declarations or transitions do not establish a path from the model root, so they do not rebut the reachability violation.
decisions.violated_obligation: The required CollisionAvoidance operating scope must be reachable from the model root.

decisions.basis: Pair-0029 dossier for NL6 HighwayMode termination, exact target and continuation facts, and source contract.
decisions.reason: NL6 states that HighwayMode ends at FinishState when auto_finished=true. The exact reachable target is not explicit-final, and its ancestor chain admits guard-free continuations ['tr_0005', 'tr_0023', 'tr_0027']. The supplied contract identifies termination, while the exact continuation facts establish that endpoint existence alone does not make termination stable; no competent intentional-terminal reading is supported by a formal terminal edge or explicit terminal fact.
decisions.violated_obligation: HighwayMode must terminate stably at FinishState when auto_finished=true.

decisions.basis: Pair-0029 dossier for NL10 UrbanMode termination, exact target and continuation facts, and source contract.
decisions.reason: NL10 states that UrbanMode exits to FinishState when auto_finished=true. The exact reachable target is not explicit-final and its ancestor chain admits guard-free continuations ['tr_0005', 'tr_0023', 'tr_0027']. The exact continuation facts establish failed stable termination, and no supplied terminal edge or explicit terminal fact supports an intentional-terminal rebuttal.
decisions.violated_obligation: UrbanMode must terminate stably at FinishState when auto_finished=true.

decisions.basis: Pair-0029 dossier for NL2 InitialState-to-HighwayMode transition guard, exact binding, S5 plan, and candidate observation.
decisions.reason: NL2 requires the InitialState-to-HighwayMode alternative to retain the independent guard 'high_way=true'. The exact bound carrier transition:line:106 has guard=null. The supplied typed facts reject substituting an event or trigger field for the required guard.
decisions.violated_obligation: The exact InitialState-to-HighwayMode transition must have guard 'high_way=true'.

issues.basis: NL3; exact source edge tr_0005; closed transition:line:24 has guard R45RouteToken == 5 and no trigger; verify check initial-entry:transition:line:24 is refuted.
issues.expected: HighwayMode begins directly in enter_hwy through an owner-local default entry without a runtime guard.
issues.observed: The owner-local edge in scope HighwayMode targets enter_hwy but has guard R45RouteToken == 5; the finite check reports the initial-entry fact as refuted.
issues.reason: The exact HighwayMode owner-local initial edge reaches enter_hwy, but it is guarded by R45RouteToken == 5. The supplied requirement describes an unconditional beginning in enter_hwy, so the broader default-entry property is not represented by the existing endpoint alone.
issues.requirement_quote: In the HighwayMode state, the system begins in the enter_hwy substate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The endpoint is correct and the guard may be an implementation routing mechanism, but the supplied inspection fact explicitly records the guarded initial edge rather than an unconditional default entry.
issues.title: HighwayMode default entry is conditional

issues.basis: NL7; exact source edge tr_0012; closed transition:line:61 has guard R45RouteToken == 12 and no trigger; verify check initial-entry:transition:line:61 is refuted.
issues.expected: UrbanMode begins directly in enter_urban through an owner-local default entry without a runtime guard.
issues.observed: The owner-local edge in scope UrbanMode targets enter_urban but has guard R45RouteToken == 12; the finite check reports the initial-entry fact as refuted.
issues.reason: The exact UrbanMode owner-local initial edge reaches enter_urban, but it is guarded by R45RouteToken == 12. The requirement states direct initial entry, while the deterministic initial-entry fact identifies the guarded edge as refuted.
issues.requirement_quote: In UrbanMode, the system begins in the enter_urban substate.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The endpoint is correct and the guard may implement routing, but it still makes the owner-local initial edge conditional under the supplied deterministic fact.
issues.title: UrbanMode default entry is conditional

issues.basis: NL10; source transition tr_0026 maps UrbanMode to FinishState; closed transition:line:102 resolves UrbanMode to HighwayMode with guard R45RouteToken == 26; transition:line:26 separately enters FinishState under that token.
issues.expected: A transition with source UrbanMode and target FinishState under auto_finished=true.
issues.observed: The closed model has transition:line:102 from UrbanMode to HighwayMode, while FinishState is reached by transition:line:26 from an initial pseudostate in HighwayMode.
issues.reason: The exact UrbanMode completion relation is not a direct UrbanMode-to-FinishState edge in the closed model. The source-mapped completion transition uses a route-control guard and targets HighwayMode; the nested FinishState entry is a separate guarded edge, so the required endpoint pair is absent as an exact closed transition.
issues.requirement_quote: The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The protected compiler route may be intended to realize the source-level cross-composite transition through a token-mediated sequence, but the supplied closed inventory does not expose a single direct UrbanMode-to-FinishState endpoint pair.
issues.title: UrbanMode completion routes to HighwayMode

issues.basis: NL12; source:state:CollisionAvoidance; source:state:CollisionAvoidance.collision_avoidance_deactive; state:CollisionAvoidance:line:89; state:collision_avoidance_deactive:line:90; transition:line:92; finite reachability checks for CollisionAvoidance and collision_avoidance_deactive.
issues.expected: The collision avoidance system is initialized into collision_avoidance_deactive through its owner-local initial edge and is reachable from root initialization.
issues.observed: The closed-model owner-local initial edge transition:line:92 targets collision_avoidance_deactive, but CollisionAvoidance and that target are unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact owner-local initial edge exists, but the CollisionAvoidance owner and its target are unreachable from the top-level initial entry. The required operational initialization therefore cannot occur from the model root.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source and closed model both contain an owner-local initial edge to collision_avoidance_deactive; the concern depends specifically on the supplied root-reachability semantics.
issues.title: Collision avoidance initial entry is outside root reachability

issues.basis: NL12; source:state:CollisionAvoidance.collision_avoidance_deactive; source:state:CollisionAvoidance.collision_avoidance_active; transition:line:93; activation event; unreachable-state and unreachable-consumer facts.
issues.expected: The declared activation response is operationally consumable from a reachable collision-avoidance state.
issues.observed: The activation transition exists, but its consumer transition is not reachable from top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact activation transition and its declared event are present, but the transition's consumer state is unreachable from root initialization. This candidate records the behavioral consequence while preserving the endpoint contract's exact source and target.
issues.requirement_quote: A transition from collision_avoidance_deactive to collision_avoidance_active must exist under any stated activation condition.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact endpoint and activation event are present; only operational reachability is deficient, and an external entry into CollisionAvoidance would rebut the concern.
issues.title: Collision activation has no reachable consumer

issues.basis: NL13; source:state:CollisionAvoidance.collision_avoidance_active; source:state:CollisionAvoidance.collision_avoidance_deactive; transition:line:94; recovery event; unreachable-state and unreachable-consumer facts.
issues.expected: The declared recovery response is operationally consumable after collision_avoidance_active is reached.
issues.observed: The recovery transition exists, but its consumer transition is not reachable from top-level initial entry because CollisionAvoidance is unreachable.
issues.reason: The exact recovery transition and declared recovery event are present, but the active state and its consumer are unreachable from root initialization. This records the operational consequence without converting it into an endpoint mismatch.
issues.requirement_quote: A transition from collision_avoidance_active to collision_avoidance_deactive must exist when there is no active danger.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact recovery edge and event are present; the concern is limited to the supplied root-reachability facts.
issues.title: Collision recovery has no reachable consumer
